title: Turkish Delight Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert inspired by the flavors of the Ottoman Empire.
instructions: Combine the pudding mix and milk in a medium saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the pudding comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in the sugar, vanilla extract, and melted butter.
Add the crushed Turkish Delight and stir until well combined.
Pour the pudding mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled and garnished with additional crushed Turkish Delight if desired.
